state:
**Side goal `website-overhaul`: stage 5 (Install and Guides) is in progress. Install, the Tour, Why people pick Novis and Simple programs are done, and `--check guides` is written.**

Install has four pages under `install/`, snippets under `website/snippets/install/`. Novis has no release yet, so the install page builds from source.

The Tour is `guides/tour/index.mdx` and ten steps. Novis has no free functions (`E0215`), so every snippet uses a class. A compile error or `nvs test` output is shown as a `txt` block copied from a real run.

Why people pick Novis is `guides/why-novis/index.mdx` and 11 candidate pages. The user curates the final list when the goal lands.

Simple programs is `guides/simple-programs/index.mdx` and six pages. Each program has its own folder under `website/snippets/guides/simple-programs/<name>/`, because an `nvs.toml` there configures every snippet in the folder. The page shows that `nvs.toml` as a `toml` block. A request program (`json-api`, `form-handler`) has a `.nvsr`. The scraper uses `Core\Test::answerHttp`, so it runs without a network.

`--check guides` (`guidesProblems` in `tools/nv/cmd/site.ts`) fails now only on the five sections not written yet. `site structure`, `stale`, `reference`, `syntax` and `--build` pass. `snippets` and `prose` fail only on `index.mdx`, `sponsoring.mdx` and `in-depth/what-changed.mdx`, which stage 6 rewrites. `apps` and `in-depth` are stubs (`LATER` in `site.ts`).

A page whose `covers:` names a feature id needs `bun nv site --stamp <page>` before `--check stale` passes.
